title: Sidemen in his first trumpet band
summary: The trombone, reed, drum, banjo and bass players in his first group once he began trumpet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Oh, let's see, who were some of your favorite trombone players when you started out?
Well, LaVoy used to play with me. I've been trying my best to get in touch with him, but I can't find him. Sam Williams, he was a nice trombone player.
When I first started, I had Sam Williams, Sam Robinson, that's Jim Robinson's brother.

He played clarinet and sax. And Walter Nolan, I think you met him some time back, he played drum. Well he was a close, close friend to Chris Kelly. He played drums and I had a fellow, Lawrence Martin, he's a little carrier now. He played the banjo. And I forgot who was playing. Yeah, Jose Harris used to play the bass violin. Sixth person.
That was before you joined up with Morgan and Son Leger?
Well no, when I was playing, I was playing the drum with them.
I was playing the drum with that band. But I mean I started playing the trumpet, that's the time I got this first group together.
Yeah, but I mean you played drums with Son Leger.
Yeah, but the fellas I mention now is the fellas that played with me on the horn.
When I was playing the horn, the trumpet. Oh yeah.
That's when you first started playing the trumpet.
Yeah, that's when you first started playing the trumpet. Yeah, that's when you first started.
Did you play stadium or did you play?
I was jobbing around, I played a poet's violin like I tell you. Chris would get those jobs, like I said, so many different people and he'd send me and send that fella and send so and so and so.
